modmenu.descriptionTranslation.controlmo: Disable mobs, adjust spawn rates, mob caps, despawn and spawn rules from an in-game menu.
controlmobspawns.title: Control Mob Spawns
controlmobspawns.message.no_permission: You do not have permission to change the Control Mob Spawns configuration.
controlmobspawns.gui.yacl_missing: The configuration screen needs YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL). Install it to edit the settings in game.
controlmobspawns.gui.home.global.hint: Applies to every world, unless a world overrides a value.
controlmobspawns.gui.home.world.hint: Overrides the global values for this world only. Only the values that differ from the global configuration are saved.
controlmobspawns.gui.home.missing_on_ser: Control Mob Spawns is not installed on this server.
controlmobspawns.config.open.mobs.desc: Spawn rate, bans, spawn types, NBT, spawn rules and despawn for each mob.
controlmobspawns.config.open.biome_spawn: Make mobs spawn naturally in biomes where they normally do not.
When off, the settings only affect Minecraft's own mobs.
controlmobspawns.config.coverage.eggs.de: When on, bans also block spawn eggs, dispensers and the /summon command. Disabled spawn types always apply.
controlmobspawns.config.coverage.existin: Remove banned mobs already in the world
When on, banned mobs are removed when their chunk loads and when the configuration is saved. Named and tamed mobs are removed too.
controlmobspawns.config.despawn.item_pic: Mobs that picked up an item can despawn
In vanilla, a mob that picks up an item never despawns. When on, it despawns normally and drops the picked-up items.
controlmobspawns.config.despawn.force_na: Mobs set to 'Force despawn' also despawn when they have a name tag. Tamed mobs never do.
controlmobspawns.config.permission_level: Operator level a player needs on a dedicated server to change this configuration or remove mobs (2 = cheats such as /gamemode). The singleplayer world owner can always edit.
controlmobspawns.config.caps.option: Maximum number of mobs of this category around players (vanilla: %s). Changing the spawn rate of a mob only changes which mobs fill this cap: to have more or fewer mobs overall, change the cap.
Mobs farther than this from every player despawn immediately (vanilla: %s blocks).
controlmobspawns.config.despawn.random.d: Beyond this distance, idle mobs can despawn at random (vanilla: %s blocks).
controlmobspawns.gui.mobs.title: Mobs
controlmobspawns.gui.spawn_rate.hint: Weight of the mob in natural spawning, 100 = vanilla. Above 0, no upper limit. To stop a mob from spawning, ban it.
controlmobspawns.gui.mob.title: Settings: %s
controlmobspawns.gui.despawn_mode.hint: Default: vanilla behaviour. Never: the mob never despawns because of distance. Force: the mob despawns even when it would normally stay (tamed mobs excluded).
controlmobspawns.gui.ids.no_suggestions: No suggestions here: type an id (namespace:path) or a tag (#namespace:path) in the search box.
controlmobspawns.gui.ids.hint: Tags start with # and match every biome they contain.
controlmobspawns.reason.chunk_generation: Animals placed when new terrain is generated.
controlmobspawns.reason.structure.hint: Mobs placed with structures (villagers, witch huts, monuments…).
controlmobspawns.reason.mob_summoned.hin: Iron golems from villagers, vexes from evokers…
controlmobspawns.reason.jockey.hint: Mounts and riders created together (chicken jockeys, spider jockeys…).
controlmobspawns.reason.event.hint: Raids, wandering traders, phantoms, zombie sieges…
controlmobspawns.reason.conversion.hint: A mob turning into another (zombie to drowned, villager to witch…). Blocking it makes the original mob disappear.
controlmobspawns.reason.triggered.hint: Spawns triggered by a block or an action (silverfish from infested blocks, wardens…).
controlmobspawns.reason.bucket.hint: Fish and axolotls released from a bucket.
controlmobspawns.reason.spawn_item_use.h: Spawn eggs used by a player.
controlmobspawns.reason.dispenser.hint: Spawn eggs used by a dispenser.
controlmobspawns.gui.nbt_bans.title: NBT bans
controlmobspawns.gui.nbt_bans.hint: Blocks the mob when the NBT value at the path matches, as in /data. Example: path IsBaby, value 1b blocks baby zombies.
controlmobspawns.gui.nbt_proportions.hin: Forces the share of spawned mobs that get each value. Example: path IsBaby, value 1b, 20%% gives 20%% babies and 80%% adults. For each path, the percentages add up to at most 100%%; the rest keeps the vanilla value, except for a single boolean value whose rest gets the opposite value. Not applied to /summon, conversions, buckets and breeding.
controlmobspawns.gui.nbt_proportions.lim: Values are applied after the game has set the mob up. Some choices made then stay: a baby zombie can already be riding a chicken, and changing its age afterwards does not remove the chicken.
controlmobspawns.gui.nbt_proportions.che: Shows a warning for each path whose percentages add up to more than 100%%.
controlmobspawns.gui.rule.title: Spawn rule
controlmobspawns.gui.rule.hint: When enabled, these conditions replace the mob's own spawn conditions (light, block, height…), which lets it spawn where it normally cannot. Empty fields mean no limit. The position must still suit the mob (on the ground, in water…).
controlmobspawns.gui.rule.range.hint: Minimum and maximum, both included. Leave empty for no limit.
controlmobspawns.gui.rule.blocks_below.h: Blocks or #tags the mob can spawn on. Empty means any block.
controlmobspawns.gui.biome_spawns.title: Biome spawns
controlmobspawns.gui.biome_spawns.hint: Adds a mob to the natural spawns of the chosen biomes. The weight is compared with the other mobs of the same category (most vanilla mobs have 5 to 100). The mob must still find a valid position: add a spawn rule if its own conditions are too strict.
controlmobspawns.gui.biome_spawns.column: Mob id · biomes · weight · min · max group size
controlmobspawns.gui.current.despawn_all: Removes every mob of this type now, in the selected dimension. One-off action for testing: it does not change the configuration.
controlmobspawns.config.current.desc: Mobs currently in the world and their counts, with shortcuts to ban or remove them.
Counts the mobs again. Values changed in the other tabs are kept.
controlmobspawns.gui.nbt_picker.title: NBT paths of %s
controlmobspawns.gui.nbt_picker.open: List of this mob's NBT paths
controlmobspawns.gui.nbt_picker.hint: Paths read on a newly created mob and on the mobs of this type already in the world, with the values seen. Choose a path alone, or a path with one of its values.
controlmobspawns.gui.nbt_picker.world_on: The list of NBT paths is only available in a world (the server reads it from the mobs).
controlmobspawns.config.current.despawn_: When on, the Despawn button of a row removes the mobs of the dimension you are in. When off, it removes them in every dimension. To target another dimension, use ⚙ on the row.
controlmobspawns.config.current.row.desc: Hover the row to show its buttons: Despawn (one-off removal, does not change the configuration), Allowed/Banned, and ⚙ for the detailed settings and per-dimension despawn.
